descriptor.scene: A warm evening block party fills the frame with ORDINARY PEOPLE AND THEIR SMALL HELPERS: at LEFT a silver-haired teacher sits on a folding chair reading to children while TWO CORAL HOLOGRAPHIC SUB-AGENTS in white sailor caps hold her picture books in a patient stack; at CENTER a doctor in scrubs laughs with a neighbor while a sub-agent at her elbow holds up a small stack of paper for her morning; at RIGHT neighbors string festival lights between porches while a sub-agent steadies the ladder and another carries the bulb bucket. Long tables, casseroles, kids chalking the pavement. Every agent is helping hands, never the hero. Dusk gold. Lower-right: chalk drawings on pavement, calm, no figures.
descriptor._caption: The coming years belong to people like this. Teachers with a thousand patient helpers. Doctors whose agents read every new paper overnight. Neighbors who can organize a block as easily as a group chat. People who choose their evolution on purpose, and choose it for the rest of us too.
descriptor.anonymous: The whole block: teacher, doctor, neighbors, children, all visibly distinct from one another; nobody resembles David and nobody wears a sky-blue button-down.
